items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Richards wrote a lot too.

ctx.x: He had quite a stable of arrangers on this date. He had Johnny Richards, Pete Rugalo, Gene Roland, Bob Graettinger. So already quite a stable of arrangers.

Yeah. Those were guys who had been writing for him. Some of those were old charts. When I was on the band, Bill Russo and I were the two main writers. Johnny Richards wrote a lot too. Russo and I were the only guys playing in the band that wrote for it.
Looking through the discography, it looks like there – you – a profusion of recordings from this period with Kenton.
